# Phase One: Discovery and Competing Architectures

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

Like light seeking a vessel, search visibility must follow the real data path rather than a guessed facade; Awtsmoos.com should speak the same truth to users and crawlers alike.

## Architecture candidates to test against the repository

- Server rendering at the existing request handler: fetch public content and emit semantic HTML before client scripts run.
- Route-level dynamic HTML transform: retain static assets but let the server enrich known content routes with metadata and body markup.
- Static pre-generation for discoverable public entities: generate HTML snapshots during build/deploy from public APIs.
- Hybrid shell plus SEO payload: emit complete semantic article/list content in HTML and let the existing client replace/enhance it after hydration.
- Dedicated content endpoints with canonical links: only if existing route constraints make initial-response HTML impossible.

## Selection criteria

- Uses existing source of truth.
- No crawler-only behavior.
- Scales to all public Heichel/post/series URLs.
- Handles Hebrew and long-form Torah text safely.
- Produces canonical URLs and meaningful status codes.
- Avoids duplicate content and private-content leakage.
- Fits current server/deployment architecture.
